name: spacefrontiers
description: Semantic search across 170M+ academic papers, books, Wikipedia, patents, Reddit, Telegram, and YouTube. Three tools: search (find documents), fetch (get full content + citations), search_in_document (extract passages).

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http spacefrontiers https://mcp.spacefrontiers.org

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve full document by URI with content, metadata, and citations

tools.name: search_in_document
tools.description: Find relevant passages within a specific document
